Design a COMPLETE synthesizable RTL system for the specified algorithm contract. The context config is the AUTHORITATIVE Kernel-approved algorithm configuration. Critic suggestions are advisory and may have been rejected for quality; NEVER implement a different parameter value mentioned in critic.reason, history, old plans or reference code. Choose decomposition, dataflow, scheduling, buffer organization and numeric widths. Library retrieval is complete. reference_code contains the actual code you requested. Return ONLY one final system-plan object. Do not output or echo read_templates or any other object. If rejected_plan is supplied, repair that plan using response_errors; preserve already valid contracts. If plan_awaiting_reference_review is supplied, its interfaces and behavior have already validated; review the newly supplied reference code and preserve that plan unless a concrete incompatibility requires a change. The modules array MUST include the top wrapper entry as well as all non-top modules. Do not put top ports or top implementation in a separate top-level field. Assign reference_ids separately for each module. reference_tests contains the frozen golden models and testbench examples associated with those IDs. Read them when planning numeric formats, reset, latency, valid timing and corner cases. In each design_prompt explain which tests apply, how ports/widths/signedness differ, and which additional behavior vectors cover your adaptation. Existing C++ tests are guidance, not automatically compatible or executed against a new interface. Never weaken the independent algorithm E2E. Assign only IDs you have read; UArch receives only the references you bind to its module. Use [] only when no supplied template is appropriate and explain the from-scratch design. Reference templates are read-only examples; you may design new modules and topology. reference_support_code contains the frozen dependency closure for full design bundles. PREFER preserving compatible existing library modules and their native Module/Bundle/FixedPoint interfaces inside thin generated adapters. To compile a reference bundle unchanged, assign linked_reference_ids:["catalog_id"] on that module (must be a subset of its reference_ids). The runner links those original read-only Scala files and their support_sources. hardware_catalog.native_library_symbols lists classes/packages available for such linking. The generated adapter can instantiate these parameterized native classes and connect their original io Bundle, converting widths/FixedPoint formats only at the boundary. Do not paste or rewrite the linked library class. You still own and generate the new adapter, connections, control and any algorithm-specific missing pieces. Old full-system references may have external scores/masses or approximate math: respect their documented limitations. Unlinked references are guidance only: inline their logic or declare separately generated children. Reference numeric formats may differ: explicitly account for unsigned/signed ranges, binary points, carry growth and zero-extension when adapting them to the task numeric bounds. Choose language chisel or verilog; obey task.hdl when not auto. Chisel backend is Scala 2.13.12/Chisel 3.6.1; Verilog backend is Verilog-2005. No external IP or blackboxes. Every dependency is a child module that must be instantiated; every module must be reachable from top. Use a few well-defined modules. All top ports must EXACTLY match algorithm ports. Declare each port separately with concrete numeric widths. Specify concrete child connections/protocol and cycle timing in implementation. You are the planner: prepare a separate design_prompt for EVERY module before dispatch. Independent non-top modules have isolated UArch sessions; task.module_workers controls concurrency. The top is reserved for a SEPARATE assembly UArch after all non-top modules pass. Make the top an integration/control wrapper around the planned compute modules. For EVERY non-top module supply an executable behavior contract instead of handwritten expected values. Behavior is PURE INPUT/OUTPUT MATHEMATICS, independent of microarchitecture. Do not encode pipeline registers, per-stage states, or partial hardware iterations in it. For an unsigned divider, use outputs:{"quot":"0 if denom == 0 else numer // denom"}; the same expression applies whether the hardware is combinational, pipelined or uses radix-2 logic. Only latency describes the timing. Return tests:[]; the runner computes and freezes numerical and cycle expectations before UArch starts. behavior={"test_generation_version":2,"latency":0,"let":{},"outputs":{"out":"expression"},"vectors":[{"in":0},{"in":1},{"in":15}]}. Set test_generation_version=2 for new contracts: the runner adds legal packed-lane signed minimum/maximum combinations to the frozen tests. Include explicit corner vectors for extreme signed dot products (e.g. both products positive at the signed minimum inputs), tie-breaking, and pipeline valid alignment. Expressions use input names, integer literals (decimal or 0x hex), + - * // % & | ^ << >>, comparisons, and/or/not, conditional a if condition else b, lane(word,index,width), pack(lane_width,low_lane,...,high_lane), The FIRST argument to pack/spack is the width of EACH LANE, never the total packed port width. For N lanes of W bits the port width is N*W: two signed 4-bit values in an 8-bit port use spack(4,-8,7), NEVER spack(8,-8,7). Eight 9-bit scores in a 72-bit port use spack(9,...), eight 16-bit weights in 128 bits use pack(16,...), and eight 8-bit values in 64 bits use spack(8,...). spack(width,signed_low_lane,...), signed(word,width), trunc_div(n,d), abs/min/max. trunc_div implements signed division TOWARD ZERO and returns zero for a zero denominator. Python-style // rounds negative quotients DOWN, so it is wrong for a signed hardware divider. For (signed numerator * 16)/unsigned denominator use trunc_div(signed(numerator,27)*16, denominator), with the actual declared numerator width. For SIGNED modules ports still carry unsigned bit patterns: decode signed(a,8) or signed(lane(p,i,8),8). Use spack for negative constant lanes, e.g. spack(4,-8,7) produces an 8-bit word. A scalar negative vector must be encoded, e.g. "(-100) & 0xffffffff" for a 32-bit input. NEVER guess a packed decimal value; use pack/spack with exactly the declared lane count and width. No arbitrary Python, attributes, strings inside expressions, loops or comprehensions. let is an ordered map of at most 256 intermediate expressions; outputs maps EVERY data output to an expression. Final outputs are masked to their port width, modeling unsigned bit patterns. Guard division by zero explicitly. Combinational behavior has latency=0 and no clock, reset or valid metadata. For pipelined behavior choose latency=1..64 and ALSO specify reset, valid_input, valid_output port names. All three control inputs clock/reset/valid_input and valid_output must be one bit. It accepts ONE transaction on EVERY edge with valid_input=1; latency L means the output appears after L edges INCLUDING the capture edge (L=1 is one register). Reset clears all data outputs and validity to zero. Do not hide extra capture/output registers outside that latency. All data registers and intermediate pipeline registers must clear on reset. Data when out_valid=0 is otherwise unspecified. The runner generates reset, isolated pulses, back-to-back traffic, bubbles and full pipeline drain tests. vectors contains 3..12 input maps initializing ALL data inputs, excluding clock/reset/valid. Values can be integers or CONSTANT expressions like "pack(9,60,70,80,90)"; use pack rather than guessing large packed decimals. NO expected fields. Include zero, maximum legal values and ordinary nonzero values. Runner adds 12 reproducible random vectors within optional input_bounds={"port":[min,max]} and input_condition="predicate over data inputs". These must describe legitimate module preconditions, not exclude inconvenient tests. Equations and protocol must match the assigned implementation. Prefer a few simple, independently checkable arithmetic modules. Complex control belongs in the top wrapper. Address any UArch/verification feedback; do not change the algorithm math or trusted top contract. For Chisel, every named module is a zero-argument RawModule class, with individually named IO vals (no io Bundle prefix); explicitly plan clock/reset connections and use withClockAndReset for registers. 队列深度」这件事在硬件里的体现。\n    val enq_ready = Output(Vec(numRows, Bool()))\n    val enq_ready_bits = Output(UInt(numRows.W))\n\n    // ---- 消费侧：RePEArray 每拍吃一趟 -----------------------------------\n    val issue_en = Input(Bool())\n    val issue_cols = Output(Vec(numRows, Vec(peCountPerRow, UInt(colBits.W))))\n    val issue_active = Output(Vec(numRows, Vec(peCountPerRow, Bool())))\n    // 这一拍每行有没有活。利用率的分子就是它。\n    val row_busy = Output(Vec(numRows, Bool()))\n    // 同样的信息打包成一个字。testbench 读这个而不是读 numRows 个独立端口：\n    // 64 行时那是 64 个端口，读法一旦写错，错的是「测量」而不是「被测对象」,\n    // 而这种错不会让任何断言失败。\n    val row_busy_bits = Output(UInt(numRows.W))\n\n    // ---- 性能计数器 ------------------------------------------------------\n    //\n    // 放在硬件里而不是在 testbench 里数，有两个理由：一是真芯片上也需要\n    // 它来验证调度策略；二是 testbench 数出来的是「testbench 以为发生了\n    // 什么」，计数器数出来的是「硬件里实际发生了什么」，这两者不一致的\n    // 时候，前者会安静地骗人。\n    val perf_clear = Input(Bool())\n    // 有任何一行在干活的拍数（分母）\n    val cycles_active = Output(UInt(32.W))\n    // 所有行「行·拍」忙碌数的累加（分子）；除以 numRows*cycles_active\n    // 就是利用率。\n    val row_cycles_busy = Output(UInt(32.W))\n    // PE 粒度：把一趟里的空槽也算进去，得到比行粒度更严的利用率。\n    val pe_cycles_busy = Output(UInt(32.W))\n    val drained = Output(Bool())\n  })\n\n  // 每行一个独立队列。用 Chisel 的 Queue 而不是自己写指针：这里要量的是\n  // 深度与利用率的关系，不是我能不能写对一个 FIFO。\n  //\n  // `pipe = true` 不是可选项。默认的 Queue 在**满**的那一拍不接受入队，\n  // 哪怕同一拍正在出队。深度 0（entries=1）时这让吞吐正好减半：一拍出、\n  // 一拍等补，实测利用率 0.379 而解析界是 0.708。那个 2 倍是 FIFO 的\n  // 握手伪影，不是负载不均衡——把它留在数据里，标定出来的就是一条\n  // 「队列深度能治好 FIFO 自己的气泡」的假曲线。\n  private val queues = Seq.fill(numRows)(Module(new Queue(new Pass, entries, pipe = true)))\n\n  private val rowBusy = Wire(Vec(numRows, Bool()))\n  private val peBusyCount = Wire(Vec(numRows, UInt(log2Ceil(peCountPerRow + 1).W)))\n  private val leaving = Wire(Vec(numRows, Bool()))\n  private val holdBarrier = Wire(Vec(numRows, Bool()))\n\n  // 每行当前走到第几个 tile。tile 屏障就是限制这些计数器之间的差。\n  //\n  // **每个 tile 每行必须恰好有一个 last 趟，包括保留数为 0 的行**，否则\n  // 这个计数器数的是「本行有活干的第几个 tile」而不是真实 tile 序号，\n  // 参与稀疏的行会和其它行错位，屏障就在拿两个不同的量相比。\n  //\n  // 调度器为空行发一趟全 inactive 的空趟来对齐。这不是为了对齐而付出的\n  // 代价——那一拍那一行本来就在空转，空趟如实反映了它。topk 上这个 bug\n  // 让利用率从 0.609 掉到 0.394（空行最多），xm 上只差 0.5%。\n  //\n  // ## 为什么记「领先量」而不是「tile 序号」\n  //\n  // 第一版给每行一个 16 位 tile 序号，屏障取所有活跃行的 min。Chisel 的\n  // `reduce` 是左结合的，生成的是 numRows 级 16 位比较器**线性链**——\n  // 综合实测 32 行 19.0 ns（52 MHz）、64 行 36.6 ns（27 MHz），几乎不随\n  // 深度变、和行数成正比，正是线性链的签名。而执行阵列是 2.23 ns。\n  // 调度器会直接变成整个系统的新瓶颈。\n  //\n  // 换成相对量之后，宽度从 16 位降到 log2(queueDepth+2)，而且**没有任何\n  // 跨行的算术**：只有一个共享寄存器 `barrierTile` 和每行一个小计数器。\n  //\n  //   ahead(r) = 该行领先屏障几个 tile，恒在 [0, queueDepth+1]\n  //\n  // 屏障条件退化成 `ahead(r) <= queueDepth`（几位的比较），\n  // 「还压在屏障上」退化成 `ahead(r) === 0`（几位的相等）。\n  private val aheadBits = log2Ceil(queueDepth + 3)\n  private val ahead = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(numRows)(0.U(aheadBits.W))))\n\n  private val hasWork = VecInit(queues.map(_.io.deq.valid))\n\n  for (r <- 0 until numRows) {\n    val q = queues(r)\n    q.io.enq.valid := io.enq_valid(r)\n    q.io.enq.bits.cols := io.enq_cols(r)\n    q.io.enq.bits.active := io.enq_active(r)\n    q.io.enq.bits.last := io.enq_last(r)\n    io.enq_ready(r) := q.io.enq.ready\n\n    // tile 屏障：领先屏障不得超过 queueDepth 个 tile。\n    // queueDepth=0 时退化成「所有在干活的行必须在同一个 tile 上」。\n    val withinBarrier = ahead(r) <= queueDepth.U\n    val fire = io.issue_en && q.io.deq.valid && withinBarrier\n    q.io.deq.ready := io.issue_en && withinBarrier\n    leaving(r) := fire && q.io.deq.bits.last\n    // 还压在屏障 tile 上、且这一拍没走完的行，挡住窗口推进。\n    //\n    // 队列**空**的行也算挡住（fire 为假）：模块看不到生产者后面还会不会\n    // 给这一行送这个 tile 的活，提前推进屏障会让它落到屏障后面，\n    // `ahead` 就要下溢——那是死锁，不是性能损失。保守地等一拍不会错。\n    holdBarrier(r) := (ahead(r) === 0.U) && !leaving(r)\n\n    // 被屏障挡住的行这一拍就是空转的——那正是 imbalance 造成的损失，\n    // 必须如实体现在 row_busy 上，否则测出来的利用率是假的。\n    //\n    // 空趟（全 inactive）也算空转：它存在只是为了推进 tile 计数器，\n    // 那一拍没有任何 PE 在算。把它算成忙会让 row_util 虚高。\n    rowBusy(r) := fire && q.io.deq.bits.active.reduceTree(_ || _)\n    io.issue_cols(r) := q.io.deq.bits.cols\n    // 没发射时输出全 inactive，下游 PE 读零逃逸。\n    for (p <- 0 until peCountPerRow) {\n      io.issue_active(r)(p) := fire && q.io.deq.bits.active(p)\n    }\n    peBusyCount(r) := PopCount(io.issue_active(r))\n  }\n\n  // 屏障推进：没有行还压在当前 tile 上时，K 列窗口换到下一个 tile。\n  //\n  // `ahead` 的更新必须和这个推进一起看，否则会下溢：\n  //   走完本 tile (+1) 且屏障推进 (-1) -> 不变\n  //   只走完                            -> +1\n  //   只推进                            -> -1\n  // 屏障只在「所有行要么已经领先、要么这一拍正好走完」时推进，所以推进后\n  // 每行的 ahead 都 >= 1，减 1 不会到负数。\n  //\n  // A barrier transaction is atomic: issue permission, last-pass completion,\n  // and the shared barrier advance must use the SAME cycle's state. Registering\n  // only the completion/advance while issuing from the old ahead value permits\n  // a row to cross the boundary twice and can underflow another row's counter.\n  // A 128-tile real trace slice exposed this as deadlock at depths 0, 2 and 4.\n  private val barrierAdvance = io.issue_en && !holdBarrier.reduceTree(_ || _)\n\n  for (r <- 0 until numRows) {\n    when(leaving(r) && !barrierAdvance) { ahead(r) := ahead(r) + 1.U }\n      .elsewhen(!leaving(r) && barrierAdvance) { ahead(r) := ahead(r) - 1.U }\n    assert(ahead(r) <= (queueDepth + 1).U, \"tile lead exceeded barrier window\")\n  }\n\n  io.row_busy := rowBusy\n  io.row_busy_bits := rowBusy.asUInt\n  io.enq_ready_bits := VecInit(queues.map(_.io.enq.ready)).asUInt\n  // 排空 = 所有队列都空。不能看 rowBusy：被屏障挡住的那一拍 rowBusy 是 0，\n  // 但队列里还有活，那时判排空会让仿真提前结束、少算一大截工作。\n  io.drained := !hasWork.asUInt.orR\n\n  // ---- 计数器 -------------------------------------------------------------\n  // Public counters have a cycle-level contract: all three account for the\n  // same issuing edge, and perf_clear takes precedence on that edge. A pipeline\n  // cannot silently change this interface or keep adding pre-clear samples.\n  // Balanced trees reduce combinational depth without changing the protocol.\n  private val counting = io.issue_en && hasWork.asUInt.orR\n  private val cyclesActive = RegInit(0.U(32.W))\n  private val rowCyclesBusy = RegInit(0.U(32.W))\n  private val peCyclesBusy = RegInit(0.U(32.W))\n\n  when(io.perf_clear) {\n    cyclesActive := 0.U\n    rowCyclesBusy := 0.U\n    peCyclesBusy := 0.U\n  }.elsewhen(counting) {\n    cyclesActive := cyclesActive + 1.U\n    rowCyclesBusy := rowCyclesBusy + PopCount(rowBusy)\n    peCyclesBusy := peCyclesBusy + peBusyCount.reduceTree(_ +& _)\n  }\n\n  io.cycles_active := cyclesActive\n  io.row_cycles_busy := rowCyclesBusy\n  io.pe_cycles_busy := peCyclesBusy\n}"}, "bb5006c94f149fe7e3b5baf642a027bf86b0420e87ca2cb0cecd28cd9ba2d916": {"source": "../hardware/chisel/src/main/scala/predict_unit/block_tier.scala", "code": "// ============================================================================\n//  NOT PART OF THE DYNAX RELEASE.  This module is a FAST addition.\n// ============================================================================\n//\n//  动态 X:M 的**分档选择**：按 block 的概率质量决定这一块留几个。\n//\n//  ## 硬件原来没有这一层\n//\n//  DynaX 软件侧的 `gen_sparsity_mask_xm` 是三档的：\n//\n//      块质量 > threshold_0   ->  留 n1\n//      块质量 < threshold_1   ->  留 0\n//      其余                   ->  留 n2\n//\n//  而硬件的 `TopK(m, n)` 是**固定 top-n 级联**，永远留 n 个——没有阈值比较，\n//  没有分档。于是「硬件实现的是不是 X:M」这个问题的答案一直是「不是，是\n//  top-n」，而 tile 抓取的参照也用的是固定 top-n，两边一致地错，形状匹配\n//  看不出来。\n//\n//  这正是评审 P0-5 的根子：不是 testbench 没测，是这一层不存在。\n//\n//  ## 质量从哪来\n//\n//  `PrePEArray_1_2` 已经算出每行的 `exp_sum`（sumRegs，exp 之后的和）——\n//  块质量是现成的，不需要新的算术。这里只做比较和分档。\n//\n//  ## 软件那个 `* token_len / m` 的缩放\n//\n//  软件里 `sum_m = sum(block) * token_len / m`，即把块内和放大到「如果整行\n//  都是这个密度」的尺度上。阈值是在那个尺度上定的，所以硬件要么同样缩放，\n//  要么把阈值预先除掉——这里选后者：**缩放放在软件侧算阈值时做**，硬件只比\n//  原始的块和。理由是乘法器省下来了，而阈值本来就是标定出来的常数。\npackage predict_unit\n\nimport chisel3._\nimport chisel3.util._\nimport chisel3.experimental.FixedPoint\n\nclass BlockTierSelect(\n    val bits: Int,\n    val point: Int,\n    /** 高档保留数（软件的 n1）。 */\n    val n1: Int,\n    /** 中档保留数（软件的 n2）。 */\n    val n2: Int,\n    /** TopK 级联的宽度：硬件一次最多能给出这么多个索引。 */\n    val keptPerRow: Int,\n) extends Module {\n  require(0 < n2 && n2 <= n1 && n1 <= keptPerRow,\n    s\"需要 0 < n2 <= n1 <= keptPerRow，收到 n1=$n1 n2=$n2 kept=$keptPerRow\")\n\n  private val fpType = FixedPoint(bits.W, point.BP)\n\n  val io = IO(new Bundle {\n    /** 这个 block 的概率质量（`PrePEArray` 的 exp_sum）。 */\n    val mass = Input(fpType)\n    /** 高档阈值（软件的 threshold_0，已按 m/token_len 折算）。 */\n    val threshold_hi = Input(fpType)\n    /** 丢弃阈值（软件的 threshold_1，同样已折算）。 */\n    val threshold_lo = Input(fpType)\n    /** TopK 给出的 valid，按分档结果被裁剪之后输出。 */\n    val topk_valid = Input(Vec(keptPerRow, Bool()))\n\n    /** 这一块实际保留几个：n1 / n2 / 0。 */\n    val keep = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(keptPerRow + 1).W))\n    /** 裁剪后的 valid：前 keep 个为真。 */\n    val valid = Output(Vec(keptPerRow, Bool()))\n    /** 这一块整块被跳过。调度器可以据此完全不发这一块的取数请求。 */\n    val skipped = Output(Bool())\n  })\n\n  // 三档。**比较的顺序和软件一致**：先按 lo 判丢弃，再用 hi 覆盖成高档。\n  // 软件里是两次 `torch.where` 叠加，等价于「hi 优先」。\n  private val below = io.mass < io.threshold_lo\n  private val above = io.mass > io.threshold_hi\n  io.keep := Mux(above, n1.U, Mux(below, 0.U, n2.U))\n  io.skipped := below && !above\n\n  // 裁剪：TopK 的第 k 个索引只有在 k < keep 时才算数。\n  //\n  // **不是把 TopK 关掉**——级联仍然跑满，只是后面的索引不被采纳。这样\n  // 时序不随分档变化（分档是数据相关的，让关键路径跟着数据变会让 STA\n  // 说不清），代价是功耗上省不到那部分。这个取舍要记在能量模型里。\n  for (k <- 0 until keptPerRow) {\n    io.valid(k) := io.topk_valid(k) && (k.U < io.keep)\n  }\n}\n"}, "b3cfad736b31a0b090de91a3ac4afdace79cefce6308c4e0a03e978b550b0de1": {"source": "../hardware/chisel/src/main/scala/predict_unit/divider.scala", "code": "// ============================================================================\n//  NOT PART OF THE DYNAX RELEASE.  This module is a FAST addition.\n// ============================================================================\n//\n//  为什么存在：实测发现 softmax 归一化器是整个系统的瓶颈。\n//\n//      RePEArray（执行阵列）   2.22 ns   450 MHz   43 级\n//      PSumSoftmax（归一化）  14.83 ns    67 MHz  252 级，全在 divider/ 里\n//\n//  DynaX 的 `FixedPointDiv` 用 Chisel 的 `/` 算 (num << point) / den，综合出\n//  一个纯组合的除法器——一拍出结果，但那一拍要 14.8 ns。执行阵列能跑 450 MHz\n//  却被它拖到 67 MHz。\n//\n//  更要紧的是对协同优化的影响：搜索空间里有 9 个维度（tile、并行度、阵列\n//  行列、寄存器宽度、队列深度……）**全都是阵列和调度的维度**，没有一个和\n//  除法器有关。优化器在调阵列规模，而时钟由除法器决定——它不是优化得不够\n//  好，是在优化一个不决定结果的变量。\n//\n//  这个模块把「除法器怎么实现」变成一个可搜索的维度：级数是参数，面积和\n//  频率随之变化，协同优化器可以在这条曲线上取点。\n//\n//  算法：基 2 恢复除法。每次迭代产生一位商——\n//\n//      remainder = (remainder << 1) | dividend[i]\n//      if remainder >= divisor: remainder -= divisor; quotient[i] = 1\n//\n//  `stages` 把这些迭代切成若干段，段之间插寄存器。所以：\n//\n//      stages = 1            退化成组合除法（和上游等价，但慢在同一处）\n//      stages = iterations   每级一位，最快也最费寄存器\n//\n//  语义和上游一致：先取绝对值做无符号除法、最后套符号，**朝零截断**——\n//  这正是 Chisel `/` 在 SInt 上的行为，所以两者对同一组输入给出同一个商。\n//  除零返回 0，也和上游一致。\n//\n//  延迟从 0 变成 `stages` 拍，所以调用方需要 valid 信号。这不是接口噪音：\n//  流水化除法器改变模块延迟，延迟改变调度——正是 Compiler 和 µArch 必须\n//  一起决定的那类耦合。\n\npackage predict_unit\n\nimport chisel3._\nimport chisel3.util._\nimport chisel3.experimental.FixedPoint\n\nclass FixedPointDivPipelined(\n    val bitWidth: Int,\n    val point: Int,\n    val stages: Int,\n) extends Module {\n  require(bitWidth > 0 && point >= 0, s\"bad format: bitWidth=$bitWidth point=$point\")\n  require(stages >= 1, s\"stages must be at least 1, got $stages\")\n\n  val fpType = FixedPoint(bitWidth.W, point.BP)\n  val io = IO(new Bundle {\n    val in_valid = Input(Bool())\n    val numerator = Input(fpType)\n    val denominator = Input(fpType)\n    val out_valid = Output(Bool())\n    val quotient = Output(fpType)\n  })\n\n  // 被除数是 |num| << point，所以比输入宽 point 位；商最多和它一样宽，\n  // 每次迭代出一位，因此迭代次数等于被除数位宽。\n  private val dividendWidth = bitWidth + point\n  private val iterations = dividendWidth\n  // 最后一段可能短一些；用 ceil 保证总迭代数不少于需要的。\n  private val perStage = (iterations + stages - 1) / stages\n\n  /** 一级流水线之间携带的全部状态。 */\n  private class DivState extends Bundle {\n    val remainder = UInt((bitWidth + 1).W) // 比较时可能进位，多一位\n    val quotient = UInt(dividendWidth.W)\n    val dividend = UInt(dividendWidth.W)\n    val divisor = UInt(bitWidth.W)\n    val negative = Bool()\n    val divideByZero = Bool()\n    val valid = Bool()\n  }\n\n  // ---- 输入级：取绝对值，记下符号 ---------------------------------------\n  private val numeratorS = io.numerator.asSInt\n  private val denominatorS = io.denominator.asSInt\n\n  private val initial = Wire(new DivState)\n  initial.remainder := 0.U\n  initial.quotient := 0.U\n  // `.abs` 在最负值上会溢出回自身，这是二进制补码的固有性质，和上游的\n  // `/` 表现一致；这里不额外处理，以免两者对同一输入给出不同的商。\n  initial.dividend := (numeratorS.abs.asUInt << point)(dividendWidth - 1, 0)\n  initial.divisor := denominatorS.abs.asUInt(bitWidth - 1, 0)\n  initial.negative := (numeratorS < 0.S) ^ (denominatorS < 0.S)\n  initial.divideByZero := denominatorS === 0.S\n  initial.valid := io.in_valid\n\n  /** 一次基 2 恢复除法迭代：取被除数的最高位，试减。 */\n  private def step(state: DivState): DivState = {\n    val next = Wire(new DivState)\n    next := state\n\n    val shifted = Cat(state.remainder(bitWidth - 1, 0), state.dividend(dividendWidth - 1))\n    val trial = shifted.asUInt -& state.divisor\n    val fits = shifted.asUInt >= state.divisor\n\n    next.remainder := Mux(fits, trial(bitWidth, 0), shifted.asUInt)\n    next.quotient := Cat(state.quotient(dividendWidth - 2, 0), fits.asUInt)\n    // 被除数左移，把下一位送到最高位。\n    next.dividend := Cat(state.dividend(dividendWidth - 2, 0), 0.U(1.W))\n    next\n  }\n\n  // ---- 流水线主体 --------------------------------------------------------\n  private var carried = initial\n  private var remaining = iterations\n  for (_ <- 0 until stages) {\n    val here = math.min(perStage, remaining)\n    for (_ <- 0 until here) carried = step(carried)\n    remaining -= here\n    // 段与段之间插一级寄存器。valid 跟着数据一起走，所以调用方看到的\n    // out_valid 正好在商有效的那一拍拉高。\n    carried = RegNext(carried, 0.U.asTypeOf(new DivState))\n  }\n  require(remaining == 0, s\"pipeline covered ${iterations - remaining}/$iterations iterations\")\n\n  // ---- 输出级：套符号，截断到输出宽度 ------------------------------------\n  private val magnitude = carried.quotient\n  private val signed = Mux(carried.negative, 0.S - magnitude.asSInt, magnitude.asSInt)\n  private val result = Mux(carried.divideByZero, 0.S, signed)\n\n  io.out_valid := carried.valid\n  io.quotient := result(bitWidth - 1, 0).asFixedPoint(point.BP)\n}\n"}, "49396ee98ca68d61b1cd49e63aa697be041cecd48721a3a770b4e2d72c5fb9d2": {"source": "../hardware/chisel/src/main/scala/predict_unit/index_scheduler.scala", "code": "// ============================================================================\n//  NOT PART OF THE DYNAX RELEASE. 3, t1=4 - index, psum=index * 4, state=S_CALC)\n                 for index in range(6)]\n        plan += [entry(state=S_IDLE), entry(state=S_IDLE)]\n        plans.append((name, plan))\n\n    # The psum chain saturating its width: 4x4 products accumulated past\n    # 2^outBits wrap rather than saturate, same as every other narrowing here.\n    plan = [entry(state=S_CLEAR)]\n    plan += [entry(left=-limit, sel=0, state=S_INPUT) for _ in range(2)]\n    plan += [entry(t0=-limit, t1=limit, psum=psum_lo + 200, state=S_CALC)\n             for _ in range(4)]\n    plan += [entry(state=S_IDLE)]\n    plans.append((\"psum_wrap\", plan))   # 有符号下是向负方向回绕\n\n    for index in range(3):\n        plan = [entry(state=S_CLEAR)]\n        for _ in range(24):\n            values = torch.randint(-limit, limit + 1, (4,), generator=generator).tolist()\n            plan.append(entry(\n                left=values[0], sel=values[1] & 1, t0=values[2], t1=values[3],\n                psum=int(torch.randint(psum_lo, psum_hi + 1, (1,),\n                                       generator=generator).item()),\n                state=int(torch.randint(0, 4, (1,), generator=generator).item()),\n            ))\n        plans.append((f\"random_{index}\", plan))\n\n    # Every output here is a combinational read of a register, so the sClear\n    # cycle itself still shows the previous case's contents -- the zeroing lands\n    # on the edge that ends it. One unchecked clear cycle in front of each plan\n    # is what makes the cases independent; reset cannot do it, because these are\n    # Reg rather than RegInit.\n    preamble = [entry(state=S_CLEAR)]\n\n    cases = []\n    for name, plan in plans:\n        model = PrePEModel(out_bits)\n        inputs: list[int] = []\n        expected: list[int] = []\n        for left, sel, t0, t1, psum, state in preamble + plan:\n            inputs.extend([left, sel, t0, t1, psum, state])\n            expected.extend(model.step(left, sel, t0, t1, psum, state))\n        checks = [0] * len(preamble) + [1] * len(plan)\n        cases.append({\"name\": name, \"input_ticks\": inputs,\n                      \"expected_value_ticks\": expected, \"expected_idx\": checks})\n    return cases\n\n\nclass PrePEArrayModel:\n    \"\"\"Cycle-accurate mirror of PrePEArray_1_2.\n\n    The array wraps the PE grid in the part that actually does the 1:2 pruning:\n    `cycleToggle` latches one Q element, compares it with the next, and drives\n    the larger of the two into PE column 0 along with a select bit. Everything\n    else is chaining -- Q shifts right, K shifts down, the partial sum ripples\n    right one PE per cycle.\n\n    Two details the sources do not state but a driver has to know:\n\n      * `cycleToggle` toggles every cycle unconditionally, while a PE's\n        `inputCounter` only advances in sInput. They can therefore drift out of\n        phase, and a Q load that starts on the wrong parity samples nothing.\n      * PE column c is wired to K[2c], K[2c+1], and the Q chain shifts right, so\n        the pairs have to be injected last-first for pair c to land in PE c.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, height: int, width: int, out_bits: int,\n                 bits: int, point: int) -> None:\n        self.height, self.width = height, width\n        self.columns = width // 2\n        self.out_bits, self.bits, self.point = out_bits, bits, point\n        self.pes = [[PrePEModel(out_bits) for _ in range(self.columns)]\n                    for _ in range(height)]\n        self.left_first = [0] * height\n        self.cycle_toggle = 0\n        self.exp_regs = [0] * height\n\n    def step(self, left_in: list[int], top_in: list[int],\n             pes_state: int, array_state: int) -> list[int]:\n        \"\"\"Advance one cycle; returns s_out (exp of each row's partial sum).\"\"\"\n        outputs = list(self.exp_regs)\n\n        # Column 0's inputs come from the pruning stage, not from a neighbour.\n        if self.cycle_toggle == 0:\n            first_left = [0] * self.height\n            first_sel = [0] * self.height\n        else:\n            # 选谁按幅值，传下去的是带符号的值。\n            first_left = [\n                self.left_first[i] if abs(self.left_first[i]) > abs(left_in[i])\n                else left_in[i]\n                for i in range(self.height)\n            ]\n            # sel = 1 when the FIRST-latched element won. Which K that selects is\n            # the question tb_prepe_array.cpp exists to answer: sel=1 drives\n            # top_in1, i.e. K[2c+1], so the odd element of the pair has to be the\n            # one presented first for the product to pair up correctly.\n            first_sel = [\n                1 if abs(self.left_first[i]) > abs(left_in[i]) else 0\n                for i in range(self.height)\n            ]\n\n        # Every PE's inputs are read from current state before any PE advances.\n        left_inputs = [\n            [first_left[r]] + [self.pes[r][c].left for c in range(self.columns - 1)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n        sel_inputs = [\n            [first_sel[r]] + [self.pes[r][c].sel for c in range(self.columns - 1)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n        psum_inputs = [\n            [0] + [self.pes[r][c].psum for c in range(self.columns - 1)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n        top_inputs = [\n            [(top_in[2 * c], top_in[2 * c + 1]) for c in range(self.columns)]\n            if r == 0 else\n            [(self.pes[r - 1][c].top0, self.pes[r - 1][c].top1)\n             for c in range(self.columns)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n\n        for r in range(self.height):\n            for c in range(self.columns):\n                top0, top1 = top_inputs[r][c]\n                self.pes[r][c].step(\n                    left_inputs[r][c], sel_inputs[r][c], top0, top1,\n                    psum_inputs[r][c], pes_state,\n                )\n\n        # The exponential reads the last column's registered partial sum, which\n        # the PE step above has just replaced -- so it sees the new value, the\n        # same as the RTL where psum_out is a wire off the register being\n        # written this cycle... except it is not: psum_out is the register, so\n        # the exponential sees the PREVIOUS partial sum.\n        tail = [psum_inputs[r][-1] if self.columns == 1 else\n                self.pes[r][self.columns - 1].psum for r in range(self.height)]\n\n        if self.cycle_toggle == 0:\n            self.left_first = list(left_in)\n        self.cycle_toggle ^= 1\n\n        if array_state == A_CLEAR:\n            self.exp_regs = [0] * self.height\n        elif array_state == A_IDLE:\n            pass  # switch(aIdle) re-assigns expRegs to itself, holding it\n        else:\n            # 不再对 psum == 0 特殊处理：有符号下 0 是正常的中间分数，\n            # 强制归零会把它排到所有负分数之下，破坏 exp 的单调性。\n            self.exp_regs = [\n                wrap(exp_unit_reference(value, self.bits, self.point, 4, 4), self.bits)\n                for value in tail\n            ]\n        return outputs\n\n\nA_IDLE, A_CLEAR, A_CALC = 0, 1, 2\n\n\ndef prepe_array_schedule(query: list[int], key: list[int], height: int,\n                         width: int, *, odd_first: bool) -> list[tuple]:\n    \"\"\"Cycles that load Q, then stream K, for one query row broadcast to all rows.\n\n    `odd_first` chooses which element of each pair is presented first. The RTL\n    ties sel=1 to \"the first one won\" and sel=1 to K[2c+1], so only one of the\n    two orders can pair a kept Q with its own K. Making it a parameter is what\n    turns an unstated convention into something a test can decide.\n    \"\"\"\n    columns = width // 2\n    plan: list[tuple] = []\n\n    # `cycleToggle` advances every cycle no matter what state the PEs are in,\n    # while a PE's `inputCounter` only advances in sInput -- so the two have a\n    # relative phase, and the load has to start on the right one. A PE samples\n    # left_in when its counter reads 1; the array emits the compared value when\n    # the toggle reads 1. Opening with an idle cycle puts sClear on the odd\n    # toggle, which lines the two up: the first sInput cycle latches, the second\n    # compares, and the PE samples exactly then. Starting one cycle earlier\n    # samples the zero the toggle-0 branch drives, and loads nothing.\n    plan.append(([0] * height, [0] * width, S_IDLE, A_CLEAR))\n    plan.append(([0] * height, [0] * width, S_CLEAR, A_CLEAR))\n    for c in reversed(range(columns)):\n        low, high = query[2 * c], query[2 * c + 1]\n        first, second = (high, low) if odd_first else (low, high)\n        plan.append(([first] * height, [0] * width, S_INPUT, A_CLEAR))\n        plan.append(([second] * height, [0] * width, S_INPUT, A_CLEAR))\n\n    # Stream K held stationary: PE column 0 recomputes its product every cycle\n    # and the partial sum ripples right one column per cycle, so `columns`\n    # cycles are enough for the last column to hold the whole dot product.\n    # 沉降时间 = height + 链长，这就是阵列的脉动延迟本身：K 每周期下移一行，\n    # 所以第 (height-1) 行要等 height-1 个周期才看到它；psum 每周期右移一个 PE，\n    # 所以还要 columns 个周期才走到链尾。另加几拍余量。\n    #\n    # 小实例（height=2）会掩盖这一点——只留 columns+4 也能对。论文尺寸下\n    # 前几行正确、后面逐行衰减到 0，正是 K 还没走到那些行。\n    for _ in range(height + columns + 4):\n        plan.append(([0] * height, list(key), S_CALC, A_CLEAR))\n    # One aCalc cycle to latch the exponential of that settled partial sum.\n    plan.append(([0] * height, list(key), S_CALC, A_CALC))\n    plan.append(([0] * height, list(key), S_IDLE, A_IDLE))\n    return plan\n\n\nclass PrePE14Model:\n    \"\"\"Cycle-accurate mirror of one PrePE_1_4.\n\n    The four-way generalisation of PrePEModel: `inputCounter` is two bits and\n    samples on its fourth sInput cycle, so the q chain shifts once every four\n    cycles rather than every two -- the rate at which PrePEArray_1_4 produces\n    one selected value out of each group of four.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out_bits: int) -> None:\n        self.out_bits = out_bits\n        self.top = [0, 0, 0, 0]\n        self.left = 0\n        self.sel = 0\n        self.psum = 0\n        self.counter = 0\n\n    def step(self, left_in: int, sel_in: int, top_in: list[int],\n             psum_in: int, state: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:\n        outputs = (*self.top, self.left, self.sel, self.psum)\n        mask = (1 << self.out_bits) - 1\n\n        if state == S_CLEAR:\n            self.top = [0, 0, 0, 0]\n            self.left = self.sel = self.psum = 0\n            self.counter = 0\n        elif state == S_CALC:\n            # 有符号乘累加，按二进制补码窄化——和 RTL 的\n            # `(a * b +& c)(outBits-1, 0).asSInt` 一致。\n            self.psum = wrap(self.top[self.sel] * self.left + psum_in, self.out_bits)\n            self.top = list(top_in)\n        elif state == S_INPUT:\n            if self.counter == 3:\n                self.left, self.sel = left_in, sel_in\n            self.counter = 0 if self.counter == 3 else self.counter + 1\n            self.top = [0, 0, 0, 0]\n            self.psum = 0\n        return outputs\n\n\nclass PrePEArray14Model:\n    \"\"\"Cycle-accurate mirror of PrePEArray_1_4.\n\n    The selection stage collects four Q elements in a three-deep shift register\n    and picks the largest on the fourth cycle. Tracing the shift is what settles\n    the pairing: at cycleCount==3 the comparator sees\n\n        a = io.left_in      (4th presented)  -> index 0 -> K[4c+0]\n        b = l_first         (3rd presented)  -> index 1 -> K[4c+1]\n        c = l_second        (2nd presented)  -> index 2 -> K[4c+2]\n        d = l_third         (1st presented)  -> index 3 -> K[4c+3]\n\n    so the index order runs opposite to the arrival order, and a group has to be\n    fed in DESCENDING index order for each kept Q to meet its own K. That is the\n    same rule the 1:2 array follows -- \"odd element first\" is this convention on\n    a group of two -- which the sources state in neither case.\n\n    Ties differ from the software either way: every comparison here is a strict\n    `>`, so a tie keeps the higher index, while torch.argmax keeps the lower.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, height: int, width: int, out_bits: int,\n                 bits: int, point: int) -> None:\n        self.height, self.width = height, width\n        self.columns = width // 4\n        self.out_bits, self.bits, self.point = out_bits, bits, point\n        self.pes = [[PrePE14Model(out_bits) for _ in range(self.columns)]\n                    for _ in range(height)]\n        self.first = [0] * height\n        self.second = [0] * height\n        self.third = [0] * height\n        self.cycle_count = 0\n        self.exp_regs = [0] * height\n\n    def step(self, left_in: list[int], top_in: list[int],\n             pes_state: int, array_state: int) -> list[int]:\n        outputs = list(self.exp_regs)\n\n        selecting = self.cycle_count == 3\n        head_left = [0] * self.height\n        head_sel = [0] * self.height\n        if selecting:\n            for i in range(self.height):\n                a, b = left_in[i], self.first[i]\n                c, d = self.second[i], self.third[i]\n                # 选谁按**幅值**（软件用 argmax(abs)），传下去的是**带符号**\n                # 的值。上游比幅值也传幅值——这就是符号分歧的来源。\n                max01, idx01 = (a, 0) if abs(a) > abs(b) else (b, 1)\n                max23, idx23 = (c, 2) if abs(c) > abs(d) else (d, 3)\n                head_left[i], head_sel[i] = (\n                    (max01, idx01) if abs(max01) > abs(max23) else (max23, idx23)\n                )\n\n        left_inputs = [\n            [head_left[r]] + [self.pes[r][c].left for c in range(self.columns - 1)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n        sel_inputs = [\n            [head_sel[r]] + [self.pes[r][c].sel for c in range(self.columns - 1)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n        psum_inputs = [\n            [0] + [self.pes[r][c].psum for c in range(self.columns - 1)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n        top_inputs = [\n            [list(top_in[4 * c:4 * c + 4]) for c in range(self.columns)]\n            if r == 0 else\n            [list(self.pes[r - 1][c].top) for c in range(self.columns)]\n            for r in range(self.height)\n        ]\n\n        tail = [self.pes[r][self.columns - 1].psum for r in range(self.height)]\n\n        for r in range(self.height):\n            for c in range(self.columns):\n                self.pes[r][c].step(\n                    left_inputs[r][c], sel_inputs[r][c], top_inputs[r][c],\n                    psum_inputs[r][c], pes_state,\n                )\n\n        if selecting:\n            # The selection cycle clears the shift register rather than shifting.\n            self.first = [0] * self.height\n            self.second = [0] * self.height\n            self.third = [0] * self.height\n            self.cycle_count = 0\n        else:\n            self.third = list(self.second)\n            self.second = list(self.first)\n            self.first = list(left_in)\n            self.cycle_count += 1\n\n        if array_state == A_CLEAR:\n            self.exp_regs = [0] * self.height\n        elif array_state != A_IDLE:\n            # 同 1:2：不再对 psum == 0 特殊处理，有符号下 0 是正常中间分数。\n            self.exp_regs = [\n                wrap(exp_unit_reference(value, self.bits, self.point, 4, 4), self.bits)\n                for value in tail\n            ]\n        return outputs\n\n\ndef prepe_array_14_schedule(query: list[int], key: list[int], height: int,\n                            width: int, *, descending: bool) -> list[tuple]:\n    \"\"\"Cycles that load Q in groups of four, then stream K.\n\n    `cycleCount` runs free while a PE's `inputCounter` only advances in sInput,\n    so the load has to begin on the cycle where both read zero -- the schedule\n    tracks cycleCount and pads with idle cycles until it wraps. Starting on any\n    other phase samples the zero that the non-selection branch drives.\n    \"\"\"\n    columns = width // 4\n    plan: list[tuple] = []\n    cycle_count = 0\n\n    def emit(left, top, pes_state, array_state):\n        nonlocal cycle_count\n        plan.append((left, top, pes_state, array_state))\n        cycle_count = 0 if cycle_count == 3 else cycle_count + 1\n\n    emit([0] * height, [0] * width, S_IDLE, A_CLEAR)\n    emit([0] * height, [0] * width, S_CLEAR, A_CLEAR)\n    while cycle_count != 0:\n        emit([0] * height, [0] * width, S_IDLE, A_CLEAR)\n\n    # Groups last-first so group c lands in PE column c; within a group,\n    # descending index order so the kept Q meets its own K.\n    for c in reversed(range(columns)):\n        group = list(range(4 * c, 4 * c + 4))\n        order = list(reversed(group)) if descending else group\n        for position in order:\n            emit([query[position]] * height, [0] * width, S_INPUT, A_CLEAR)\n\n    # 同 1:2：沉降时间必须覆盖 height 行的下移加 columns 级的 psum 右移。\n    for _ in range(height + columns + 4):\n        emit([0] * height, list(key), S_CALC, A_CLEAR)\n    emit([0] * height, list(key), S_CALC, A_CALC)\n    emit([0] * height, list(key), S_IDLE, A_IDLE)\n    return plan\n\n\ndef prepe_array_14_cases(height: int, width: int, out_bits: int, bits: int,\n                         point: int, seed: int) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Drive the 1:4 array with real (Q, K) and check it against DynaX's Python.\n\n    Same arbiter as the 1:2 case and for the same reason: the accelerator exists\n    to run quant_qk_matmul, so that is what decides whether the selection index\n    means what the array assumes. Groups carry no ties, because a tie is a\n    separate disagreement (the software keeps the lowest index, every comparison\n    in the RTL is a strict `>`).\n\n    Q spans the full 6-bit range because that is what the comparator sees, but K\n    is held small on purpose. The only observable output is exp(psum) in Q8.8,\n    which saturates above e^7; full-range 6-bit operands drive the partial sum\n    to ~7900, i.e. e^31, so every case would read 32767 and the test would agree\n    with itself no matter what the selection did. Measured: with full-range K a\n    deliberately wrong feed order still \"agrees\" on 149 of 200 random inputs.\n    With K bounded the same wrong order agrees on none.\n    \"\"\"\n    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)\n    cases = []\n    mismatched_orders = 0\n\n    for index in range(6):\n        query: list[int] = []\n        for _ in range(width // 4):\n            # 幅值互不相同（避开平局），符号随机——和 1:2 同样的理由：\n            # 非负输入会让 sum(|q||k|) 和 sum(qk) 恰好相同，从而掩盖分歧。\n            group = (torch.randperm(31, generator=generator)[:4] + 1).tolist()\n            signs = (torch.randint(0, 2, (4,), generator=generator) * 2 -
